name: Ngo Quyen
role: General and founding king who ended 1000 years of Northern domination at the Battle of Bạch Đằng (938)
known_facts: Born 897 in Đường Lâm, son of the châu mục Ngô Mân
Trusted general (nha tướng) and son-in-law of Dương Đình Nghệ, holding Ái Châu
Marched north to avenge Dương Đình Nghệ and killed the traitor Kiều Công Tiễn (938)
Destroyed the Nam Hán fleet at Bạch Đằng in 938 using iron-tipped stakes and the tide, killing prince Lưu Hoằng Tháo
Proclaimed himself king in 939, founded the Ngô dynasty and moved the capital to Cổ Loa, ending 1000 years of Bắc thuộc
Died in 944 at age 47 after a six-year reign; honored by posterity as Tiền Ngô Vương
interpretation: 10th-century early-autonomy Đại Việt military dress (plain hemp tunic, sash, topknot), based on the user reference.
unknowns: No verified contemporary life portrait survives
